audit.why: Early lane is Mel's (950 Q range vs 900 daggers, W reflects Q); levels 6 through first item are Naafiri's (Hounds' Pursuit lock-on plus lethality); 2+ items swings back to Mel. Content chart matches; full chart did not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer attributes her 6 spike to 'The Call of the Pack (R)' — that is her W. Her R is Hounds' Pursuit (110/95/80s), a 900-range lock-on dash whose recast grants a shield.
audit.why: Stale pre-rework slot mapping; the kit file is authoritative.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls her dash 'Hounds' Pursuit (E)' — her E is Eviscerate. Full layer never names which of her spells beat/feed Rebuttal, and breakdown.cooldowns has no digits. Untargetability (W 26-18s) dodging Mel's burst/execute was unstated.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects Darkin Daggers (projectile); Hounds' Pursuit and Eviscerate are dashes — damage prevented but nothing reflected. Her W untargetability dodges timed burst including the R execute. E fully heals her packmates (anti-heal relevance).
audit.corrected: See edits: dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0].text, whys[2].

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Hounds' Pursuit is 110s at rank 1 — a whiffed dive is your longest kill window; commit then. - Her W untargetability is 26s early and her E dash 11s; with both down she has no escape. - Your W (38s) has one job: the R dive. Never spend it on 9s daggers.
